chain.limit: epsilon*,m*,xi,C still enter. The R8 analysis of the ruler derivation is reused; no claim that its founding energy argument was repaired.

They depend on lambda,v,m_eff and curvature; they are additional source structure, not a numerical fixing of the lens amplitude. Expansion around Psi=v is stated; verifying that v is a stationary background of the displayed massive potential is still necessary before using its spectrum.
